articles.title: Show HN: Axiom – C++ tensor library with NumPy API and Metal GPU support
articles.summary: A developer is building a C++ tensor library to bring the user-friendly ergonomics of Python's NumPy/PyTorch to native code. The project aims for a familiar API, incorporating features like operator overloading and method chaining. This initiative seeks to simplify complex numerical and machine learning operations for C++ developers, making native code development more intuitive and efficient.

articles.title: An aspirational Defence Budget
articles.summary: Defence preparedness is vital for a nation like India to enforce its strategic autonomy amidst global geopolitical instability. A strong military enables the nation to make independent choices on the world stage, safeguarding national interests without external pressure. This proactive approach ensures India remains resilient and capable of navigating complex international challenges while upholding its sovereign decisions.

articles.title: 10 Best Killer Car Movies Ever, Ranked
articles.summary: Female drivers on Los Angeles freeways are facing terror from a man dubbed 'The Fiddler'. Operating a Dodge van with tinted windows, he targets women, adding to the intimidation by playing loud fiddle music. This ongoing situation has created distress among motorists in the area, highlighting a concerning pattern of harassment.
